faq.q: What is the cheapest yacht for a stag weekend in Marbella 2034?
faq.a: The most affordable option is our Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, both at €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 pax). That works out at roughly €68 per person for a 2-hour spin along the coast. Includes skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – no hidden extras.

faq.q: Are drinks included on stag weekend charters?
faq.a: Yes. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Plus light snacks. No need to bring your own unless you want premium spirits – those can be added on request (pricing via WhatsApp).

faq.q: How far in advance should I book for a stag weekend in 2034?
faq.a: For June to September, book 4–6 weeks ahead. For May, October, or shoulder months, 2–3 weeks is usually fine. We recommend a 4-hour charter minimum for a stag group – enough time to anchor, swim, and enjoy the coast.

faq.q: Can we bring our own music on board?
faq.a: Absolutely. All our boats have Bluetooth speakers or AUX inputs. Just bring your playlist. The skipper will keep the volume at a respectful level near other boats and the harbour.

faq.q: What's the cancellation policy for stag charters?
faq.a: We operate a 7-day cancellation policy for groups of 8+. Within 7 days, 50% of the charter value is charged. For bookings made less than 7 days ahead, cancellation is non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are handled case by case.

faq.q: Can we add a jet ski to a stag charter?
faq.a: Only the Mangusta 80 (both grey and white variants) includes a free jet ski for the charter. For other boats, jet ski rental can be arranged separately – ask via WhatsApp for availability and pricing.

faq.q: Where do the boats depart from?
faq.a: All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. The marina is a 10-minute walk from most stag-friendly bars and hotels along the Golden Mile. Free parking is limited – we recommend taxis or walking.

faq.q: What's the best time of day for a stag yacht charter?
faq.a: Late afternoon (16:00–20:00) is popular – you get sunset views over La Concha and a golden hour swim stop. Morning charters (10:00–14:00) are calmer and cheaper for 2-hour slots. Evening charters (20:00–00:00) add a night vibe but cost the same as day rates.

data.body_html:
Planning a marbella stag weekend yacht budget 2034 doesn't mean guessing costs. Here's the exact breakdown per boat, what's included, and how to get the best value for your group. All prices are in euros, inclusive of VAT, skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – no surprises.

Boat Options and Prices for Stag Groups

We operate from Puerto Banús and have boats for every stag budget. The cheapest tier starts at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). That's around €68–83 per person for a short blast along the coast. For a longer day, the 8-hour rate is €2,299 – still under €210 per head for 11 people.

If your stag crew is 12 strong, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the next step up at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. That includes a free jet ski – perfect for a stag water fight or showing off. The same applies to the grey variant. All other boats (e.g. Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Azimut 58) are priced on request – just WhatsApp us for a custom quote.

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden extras. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (speaks English & Spanish)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You can bring your own food or order catering – ask us via WhatsApp for options. Premium drinks (spirits, champagne) can be added at cost.

Sample Budget Breakdown for 10 Stags

Here's a realistic cost for a 4-hour charter on the Azimut 39 (11 pax) in June 2034:

ItemCost
Boat charter (4h)€1,499
Skipper & fuelIncluded
Drinks & snacksIncluded
Extra beer/soft drinks€50 (optional)
Total€1,499
Per person (10 pax)€150

For 2 hours, the per-person cost drops to €75 – still a solid stag activity without blowing the budget. Compare that to a night out in Puerto Banús where a round of drinks can hit €100+.

When to Book for 2034

Peak season (June–September) fills up fast. For a stag weekend in August 2034, book at least 4–6 weeks ahead. May and October are quieter – 2–3 weeks is usually fine. We recommend a 4-hour charter minimum for stags: enough time to cruise past the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim, and still get back for pre-dinner drinks.

Late afternoon (16:00–20:00) is the sweet spot – you get the sunset over La Concha and cooler sea breezes. Morning slots (10:00–14:00) are better for avoiding crowds.

Tips to Maximise Your Stag Yacht Budget

  • Go for 2 hours if your group is on a tight budget – still plenty of time for photos and a quick swim stop.
  • Choose the Mangusta 80 if you want a free jet ski – that alone saves €200–300 on rental.
  • Share the charter cost equally – most groups split via Revolut or PayPal before the trip.
  • Book on a weekday (Mon–Thu) for better availability and quieter anchorages.
  • Bring your own playlist – all boats have Bluetooth.
  • Ask about catering if you want a full BBQ – we can arrange it.
